service.scope: sampled service and telemetry preflight; not task quality qualification

cost.degradation: cost is unknown for baseline, candidate: cost per pass is null rather than zero, and tokens are reported as a proxy only because they are not a price
cost.criteria_impact: cost_not_verified stays in design_blockers and this tool cannot clear it; clearing it needs metered routing or an explicit external ruling that records the cost gate as unavailable

minimum_detectable_effect.decision_rule: exact two-sided sign test over discordant tasks

notes: cohort_status is a caller declaration; this tool cannot verify that the cohort was never used during development
cohort_file_verification is null until the frozen file is supplied; without it the two arms agree on a self-reported hash, which is not evidence that either ran the file a reviewer holds
the interval resamples tasks, so repeats of one task are not treated as independent observations
a failed or unattempted run counts as a failed observation; nothing is excluded
tasks_for_target_power divides a discordant-task requirement by the observed discordance rate; it is a planning estimate, not evidence

minimum_detectable_effect simulates a shift applied to the observed per-task baseline rates and asks how often the exact sign test would reject; it describes this cohort, not the treatment, and is null when no shift below 1.0 reaches the target power
cost is summed only when every task-run of an arm carries a measured cost_usd; a null cost is reported as unknown, never as zero
independent review and production shadow validation are external gates and are never supplied by this comparison
